description: This file contains serialization and copying logic for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> in Orleans framework, including codecs and deep copiers.

classes.name: DictionaryCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializer for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> implementing IFieldCodec.

classes.name: DictionaryCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Deep copier for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> implementing IDeepCopier.

classes.name: DictionaryBaseCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Base serializer for Dictionary<TKey, TValue> implementing IBaseCodec.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a Dictionary<TKey, TValue> to a writer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a Dictionary<TKey, TValue> from a reader.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Dictionary<TKey, TValue>.

methods.name: DeepCopy (overload)
methods.description: Copies data from one Dictionary<TKey, TValue> to another.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new Dictionary<TKey, TValue> with specified capacity and comparer.
